description: This file defines the 'MacNodeModeCoordinator' class responsible for managing the lifecycle and connection to a gateway server in a macOS application. It handles starting/stopping sessions, reconnection logic, configuration updates, and event handling for the macOS node.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for coordinating the macOS node's connection to the gateway, managing state, and handling network events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the coordinator by creating a background task that runs the main loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the coordinator by canceling the ongoing task and disconnecting the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway stable ID and disconnects the current session.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main asynchronous loop that manages connection retries, configuration fetching, and session management.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines and returns the current capabilities of the node based on configuration and user defaults.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Fetches current permission statuses asynchronously and returns them as a dictionary.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of supported commands based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocketSessionBox for secure websocket connection if URL scheme is wss.
